verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents spawning multiple agents that work simultaneously under a coordinating lead agent. Its web version also lets you kick off long-running tasks and run multiple tasks in parallel in cloud sessions, so the core of parallel autonomous agents is first-party. However, nothing documents runs lasting hours or days, or fleet-scale concurrency. Missing for 10: documented multi-hour/multi-day autonomous run duration, fleet-scale limits or management, independent hands-on corroboration of long parallel runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Spawn multiple Claude Code agents that work on different parts of a task simultaneously. A lead agent coordinates the work, assigns subtasks, and merges results.
Kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done, work on repos you don't have locally, or run multiple tasks in parallel.
run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions.
Kick off a long-running task on the web or the Claude mobile app, then pull it into your terminal with `claude --teleport`.
